variants.body: A red-bellied woodpecker is announcing themselves to the whole neighborhood.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is calling near {green}
variants.body: A loud rolling kwirr, then a flash of red cap and zebra stripes on a trunk.

variants.title: A woodpecker is stashing acorns in the bark
variants.body: Wedging nuts into cracks to eat later. A winter pantry, one acorn at a time.

variants.title: Red-bellied woodpecker, pantry manager
variants.body: Every crack in the bark is a cupboard right now.

variants.title: A woodpecker is filling a pantry near {green}
variants.body: Wedging acorns and nuts into bark cracks to snack on all winter.

variants.title: A woodpecker is raiding their own pantry
variants.body: Prying out the nuts they hid in the bark back in fall.

variants.title: A zebra-striped woodpecker is out in the cold
variants.body: Red cap bright against the gray, checking the bark for snacks.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is snacking near {green}
variants.body: Digging the nuts they hid in fall out of the bark, one by one.

variants.title: A titmouse is whistling peter, peter, peter
variants.body: Loud for such a small gray bird. Look for the pointy crest.

variants.title: Peter, peter, from the trees
variants.body: That's a tufted titmouse, the curious little boss of the treetops.

variants.title: A titmouse is whistling in the trees near {green}
variants.body: Peter, peter, peter, from a small gray bird with big dark eyes and a pointy crest.

variants.title: A titmouse is leading a mixed flock
variants.body: Chickadees, woodpeckers and kinglets follow along. Titmice are the lookouts.

variants.title: The little gray boss is in charge
variants.body: When the titmouse calls an alarm, the whole flock listens.

variants.title: A mixed flock is moving through {green}
variants.body: Led by a bossy little titmouse, with woodpeckers and other small birds tagging along.

variants.title: A titmouse is collecting soft nest lining
variants.body: Hair, fur, fluff. They've been known to pluck it from a sleeping raccoon.

variants.title: Titmouse on a fluff-gathering mission
variants.body: Every soft thing goes into the nest.

variants.title: A titmouse is gathering nest fluff near {green}
variants.body: Anything soft will do, even fur from a sleeping raccoon.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is flicking through the leaves
variants.body: Hop, pause, raise the tail slowly, lower it. They're shy and very gentle.

variants.title: A spotted bird is hiding on the ground
variants.body: Brown back, spotted chest, rusty tail lifting slowly. That's a hermit thrush.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is hopping through the leaves near {green}
variants.body: Quiet and shy, lifting their rusty tail slowly, picking bugs from the leaf litter.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is singing like a flute
variants.body: A clear note, then a spiral of echoing tones. One of the loveliest songs anywhere.

variants.title: Listen: a flute in the trees
variants.body: That's a hermit thrush passing through, singing a little before heading north.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is singing near {green}
variants.body: A clear, echoing, flute-like song, rising in spirals in the evening light.

variants.title: A hermit thrush stayed for winter
variants.body: Living on berries in a sheltered thicket, quietly getting by.

variants.title: A thrush is snacking on winter berries
variants.body: When the bugs are gone, berries keep them going.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is eating berries near {green}
variants.body: Tucked in a sheltered thicket, picking at the last winter berries.

variants.title: A butter butt is flitting through the trees
variants.body: Watch for the flash of yellow above the tail as they hop from branch to branch.

variants.title: Check, check, from the branches
variants.body: A yellow-rumped warbler is calling to their flock.

variants.title: Yellow-rumped warblers are flitting through the trees near {green}
variants.body: Little gray birds flashing yellow rumps, calling check! as they go.

variants.title: A warbler is eating waxy bayberries
variants.body: Their superpower: they can digest the wax, so they survive winters other warblers can't.

variants.title: A tough little warbler is staying for winter
variants.body: Most warblers fly south. This one stays and eats berries.

variants.title: Yellow-rumped warblers are eating berries near {water}
variants.body: Plucking waxy bayberries from the shrubs, one of the few warblers who winter here.

variants.title: Warblers are passing through in their spring colors
variants.body: Bright yellow, black and white. They'll be gone north in a few weeks.

variants.title: A wave of warblers is moving through
variants.body: Spring migration! Yellow-rumps are first to arrive and most common.

variants.title: Spring warblers are moving through {green}
variants.body: Yellow-rumps in their brightest colors, stopping to feed on their way north.

variants.title: A bumble bee is wrestling a flower
variants.body: She grabs on, hums loud, and shakes the pollen loose. The flower bounces. Totally worth it.

variants.title: Pollen pants, fully loaded
variants.body: Bumble bee workers pack pollen into baskets on their back legs until they look like they're wearing orange shorts.

variants.title: A bumble bee is humming through the flowers near {green}
variants.body: Fuzzy, round and very busy, buzzing pollen loose from one bloom after another.

variants.title: A queen bumble bee is house hunting
variants.body: Big and slow, flying low over the ground, checking every hole and tuft of old grass for a nest spot.

variants.title: The first bumble bee of the year
variants.body: She slept alone underground all winter. Now she's starting a whole family by herself.

variants.title: A bumble bee queen is searching for a nest near {green}
variants.body: Flying low and slow, peeking into old burrows, looking for the perfect spot.

variants.title: A bumble bee fell asleep in a flower
variants.body: Didn't make it home before dark, so she's holding on and napping right there. Very relatable.

variants.title: Shh, a bee is sleeping
variants.body: Sometimes bumble bees spend the night clinging under a flower, waiting for the morning warmth.

variants.title: A bumble bee is napping in a flower near {green}
variants.body: Too chilly to fly home, so she's curled up in a bloom until the sun comes back.

variants.title: A honey bee is sipping nectar
variants.body: Tongue out, deep in the flower. When she gets home she'll dance to tell her sisters where it is.

variants.title: This flower is getting a good review
variants.body: A honey bee will go home and waggle-dance directions to it. Five stars.

variants.title: Honey bees are visiting the flowers near {green}
variants.body: Quick and golden, flower to flower, then straight back toward the hive with directions.

variants.title: A honey bee is taking a drink
variants.body: On hot days they carry water home and fan it with their wings to cool the hive. Built-in air conditioning.

variants.title: Bee at the water's edge
variants.body: She's collecting water for the hive, very carefully, from a damp spot.

variants.title: A honey bee is sipping water near {water}
variants.body: Carrying it home to cool the hive on a hot day.

variants.title: A honey bee swarm is resting in a tree
variants.body: Thousands of bees hanging in a ball around their queen while scouts look for a new home. They're calm, just moving house.

variants.title: A whole hive is moving house
variants.body: A swarm is gentle and busy. Give them space and they'll be gone in a day or two.

variants.title: A honey bee swarm is resting in a tree near {green}
variants.body: A buzzing ball of bees, waiting while scouts find a new home.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is hovering in your face
variants.body: That's a male, checking if you're a rival. He can't sting. He's just very committed.

variants.title: Bzzz, who goes there
variants.body: A big carpenter bee is on guard duty, hovering, turning, hovering again.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is guarding the wooden fences along {street}
variants.body: Hovering mid-air, darting at anyone who comes close. All bluff, no stinger.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is drilling a tunnel
variants.body: Listen close to old wood and you might hear a soft scraping. She's carving a perfect round door.

variants.title: A perfectly round hole just appeared
variants.body: A carpenter bee mom is carving a nursery in the wood, one chew at a time.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is carving a tunnel near {green}
variants.body: In an old bench or fence, she's chewing a perfect round tunnel for her babies.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is sneaking nectar
variants.body: Too big for some flowers, they slit the side and sip right through. Nectar robbery.

variants.title: A big shiny bee is on the flowers
variants.body: Carpenter bees look like bumble bees, but their bottoms are bald and shiny.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is visiting flowers near {green}
variants.body: Big, black and shiny, slurping nectar from the side of the blooms.

variants.title: The fireflies are starting to blink
variants.body: Low over the grass, a slow yellow swoop. Then another. Then everywhere.

variants.title: Somebody's flirting in morse code
variants.body: Male fireflies flash a J-shaped swoop. If a female in the grass likes it, she flashes back.

variants.title: Fireflies are blinking over {green}
variants.body: Slow yellow swoops rising from the grass as the sky goes dark.

variants.title: The fireflies are lighting up the dark
variants.body: Flash, pause, flash. The whole meadow is twinkling.

variants.title: Tiny lanterns all over the grass
variants.body: Each blink is someone saying hi. The answers glow from the grass.

variants.title: Fireflies are glowing along {street}
variants.body: Blinking slowly in the dark spots away from the streetlights.

variants.title: A firefly is resting on a grass blade
variants.body: By day they just look like small beetles, with a red-and-yellow shield on their head.

variants.title: Fireflies are napping until dark
variants.body: They spend the day hidden in tall grass, saving up for tonight's show.

variants.title: A firefly is resting in the grass near {green}
variants.body: Waiting for dusk, when the light show begins.

variants.title: A blue dasher is guarding the best perch
variants.body: He zips out, grabs a gnat, and lands back on exactly the same twig. Every time.

variants.title: A powder-blue dragonfly is on duty
variants.body: Wings tilted forward, green eyes scanning the water.

variants.title: A blue dasher is patrolling near {water}
variants.body: Darting out over the water and back to the same reed, again and again.

variants.title: A dragonfly is doing a handstand
variants.body: On hot days, blue dashers point their tail at the sun so less of their body gets cooked.

variants.title: Dragonfly sun salute
variants.body: Tail straight up, toward the sun. It's how they stay cool.

variants.title: A blue dasher is cooling off near {water}
variants.body: Tail pointed straight at the sun, keeping their body out of the heat.

variants.title: A dragonfly is warming up
variants.body: Wings shivering, they can't fly until their muscles are warm.

variants.title: A new dragonfly just hatched
variants.body: An empty shell on a reed and a soft new dragonfly, drying their wings in the first light.

variants.title: A blue dasher is warming up near {water}
variants.body: Perched on a reed, wings buzzing, waiting for the sun.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are having a family reunion
variants.body: Tiny red young, middle-sized kids and grown-ups, all crowded on one seed pod.

variants.title: Orange and black, all together
variants.body: A whole cluster on the milkweed pod. The colors say: we taste awful, birds.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are gathering near {green}
variants.body: Clustered on the milkweed pods, all ages together, bright orange and black.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are warming up in the sun
variants.body: Cool morning, so everyone's sitting on the sunny side of the pod.

variants.title: A milkweed pod just burst open
variants.body: Fluffy seeds drifting away, and the bugs are getting their last snacks.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are sunning near {green}
variants.body: Lined up on the sunny side of a pod, soaking up warmth.

variants.title: The turtles are stacked on a log
variants.body: Necks out, legs out, eyes half closed. Pure sun bliss.

variants.title: Turtle sunbathing club
variants.body: Every spot on the log is taken. Someone is lying on someone else.

variants.title: Turtles are basking near {water}
variants.body: Lined up on a sunny log, legs stretched out, soaking it in.

variants.title: Plop, plop, plop
variants.body: Someone walked by, and every turtle on the log slid into the water at once.

variants.title: A turtle's nose just popped up
variants.body: A little head with red stripes, peeking up, checking if it's safe.

variants.title: A turtle is peeking up near {water}
variants.body: Just a nose and two eyes above the water, checking the coast is clear.

variants.title: A turtle mom is digging a nest
variants.body: Far from the water, in sandy soil, with her back legs. Very slow. Very determined.

variants.title: A turtle is on a road trip
variants.body: Mothers leave the pond to find the perfect sandy spot for eggs.

variants.title: A turtle mom is nesting near {green}
variants.body: Digging a hole with her back feet in soft sandy soil.

variants.title: A groundhog is eating clover
variants.body: Head down, cheeks going, no thoughts, only clover.

variants.title: A groundhog just sat up to look around
variants.body: Tall and still, like a little furry fire hydrant. All clear. Back to snacks.

variants.title: A groundhog is munching clover near {green}
variants.body: Head down in the grass, chewing steadily, never far from the burrow.

variants.title: A groundhog just whistled
variants.body: A sharp alarm and a dash for the burrow. Some people call them whistle pigs.

variants.title: Groundhog babies are out
variants.body: Little ones tumbling by the burrow while mom keeps watch.

variants.title: A groundhog family is out near {green}
variants.body: Babies wrestling by the burrow entrance, mom sitting up on watch.

variants.title: A very round groundhog is heading underground
variants.body: Months of snacks, and now the big sleep. See you in spring.

variants.title: Groundhog bedtime is coming
variants.body: They're eating extra and lining the burrow with grass for winter.

variants.title: A groundhog is getting ready for winter near {green}
variants.body: Extra round, carrying grass into the burrow for a long sleep.

variants.title: A spiderweb is covered in dew
variants.body: Every thread is strung with tiny beads of water, glowing in the first light.

variants.title: Somebody built a chandelier overnight
variants.body: An orb-weaver's web, sparkling with dew. She's resting in the middle.

variants.title: A dewy spiderweb is sparkling near {water}
variants.body: Round and perfect, every thread beaded with water, glowing at dawn.

variants.title: An orb-weaver is building tonight's web
variants.body: Spokes first, then round and round. About an hour of work, done in the dark.

variants.title: A spider is knitting in the dark
variants.body: Round and round, one thread at a time, a brand new web for the night.

variants.title: An orb-weaver is spinning a web along {street}
variants.body: On a railing or fence, building a fresh round web as night falls.

variants.title: A garden spider is waiting in her web
variants.body: Yellow and black, right in the middle, next to a zigzag of silk. Patient.

variants.title: The biggest webs of the year
variants.body: Fall is when orb-weavers are fully grown. Their webs can be a few feet across.

variants.title: A big orb-weaver is waiting near {green}
variants.body: In the middle of a huge round web, very still, very patient.

variants.title: A pigeon is taking a rain shower
variants.body: One wing lifted high, leaning into the drops so the rain soaks right underneath. Eyes half closed. This is spa day.

variants.title: The pigeons are puffed up under the ledge
variants.body: Rain drumming on the awning, feathers fluffed into gray pillows, everyone pressed shoulder to shoulder and dry.

variants.title: A pigeon is rain-bathing along {street}
variants.body: Wing up, head tilted, letting the cold drops run down to the skin while the sidewalk smells like wet stone.

variants.title: The sparrows are gossiping under the eaves
variants.body: Packed in a dry corner, listening to the rain hiss on the street, chirping about it nonstop.

variants.title: A sparrow is shaking off like a tiny dog
variants.body: Brrrrp. A spray of drops, a fluff, a very offended look at the sky.

variants.title: Sparrows are sheltering deep in the hedges along {street}
variants.body: Every leaf is dripping, but in the middle of the hedge it's dry and full of chatter.

variants.title: A robin is hunting worms in the rain
variants.body: The soaked lawn smells like earth and the worms are coming up. Run, stop, head tilt. Tug.

variants.title: Worm o'clock for the robins
variants.body: Rain softens the ground and pulls worms to the surface. The robins look delighted, if damp.

variants.title: A robin is pulling worms from the wet grass near {green}
variants.body: Drops on their orange chest, a stretchy worm in their beak, the whole lawn smelling green and new.

variants.title: A squirrel is using their tail as an umbrella
variants.body: Curled up over their back and head, fluffy side out. It mostly works.

variants.title: A squirrel is waiting out the rain
variants.body: Tucked in a fork of the tree, tail wrapped around, watching the drops slide down the bark.

variants.title: A squirrel is holding their tail over their head near {green}
variants.body: A soggy little umbrella, dripping at the tip, while they nibble a snack under the leaves.

variants.title: A squirrel is snug in their leaf nest
variants.body: Rain pattering on the roof of leaves, everyone curled up warm inside.

variants.title: The squirrels are listening to the rain
variants.body: Inside a ball of leaves high in the tree, dry and cozy, tails wrapped like blankets.

variants.title: A squirrel is dry in a leaf nest near {green}
variants.body: The rain taps on the leaves outside. Inside, it's warm and smells like oak.

variants.title: Rain is rolling right off the ducks
variants.body: Their feathers are oiled, so drops bead up and slide off like tiny marbles. Perfect duck weather, honestly.

variants.title: A mallard is dabbling in the drizzle
variants.body: Every raindrop rings the pond, and the duck doesn't care at all.

variants.title: The ducks are paddling through the rain on {water}
variants.body: Raindrops dancing all around them, beads of water rolling off their backs.

variants.title: A gull is doing the worm dance
variants.body: Paddling their feet fast on the wet grass, which brings the worms up. Ridiculous. Effective.

variants.title: The gulls are facing into the rain
variants.body: All pointed the same way, like weathervanes, so the drops slide down their feathers, not under them.

variants.title: A gull is stomping for worms near {water}
variants.body: Little webbed feet tapping on the soaked grass, head cocked, waiting for a worm to pop up.

variants.title: A crow is sitting out the rain
variants.body: Hunched, feathers slicked dark and shiny, water dripping from the tip of their beak. Unimpressed.

variants.title: The crows are complaining about the weather
variants.body: A few grumpy caws from inside a tree. Same, crows. Same.

variants.title: A crow is waiting out the rain near {landmark}
variants.body: Hunched on a high perch, black feathers gleaming wet, watching the street below.

variants.title: A mourning dove is rain-bathing
variants.body: Leaning over sideways with one wing raised to the sky, letting the gentle rain fall into their feathers.

variants.title: Two doves are sharing a wet wire
variants.body: Side by side, rain dripping off the wire between them, softly cooing anyway.

variants.title: A dove is lifting a wing to the rain along {street}
variants.body: Tipped over sideways, wing up, soaking in a warm drizzle like it's a bath.

variants.title: A heron is standing perfectly still in the rain
variants.body: Neck tucked, shoulders hunched, rain dimpling the water around their legs. Waiting.

variants.title: The heron does not mind the rain
variants.body: Rain makes the fish come up to the surface. Patience is paying off.

variants.title: A great blue heron is fishing in the rain near {water}
variants.body: Gray on gray, unmoving, while drops ring the water all around.

variants.title: The geese are grazing in the rain
variants.body: Wet grass is the sweetest grass. Water sliding off their backs, heads down, munching.

variants.title: A goose is shaking the rain off
variants.body: A big ruffle from neck to tail, a spray of droplets, then right back to eating.

variants.title: Geese are grazing on the wet grass near {green}
variants.body: Shining with raindrops, honking softly, completely unbothered.

variants.title: A cardinal is tucked into the dripping hedge
variants.body: Bright red against the dark wet leaves, crest flattened, waiting for the shower to pass.

variants.title: Chip, chip from the wet bushes
variants.body: The cardinals are keeping in touch while the rain comes down.

variants.title: A cardinal is sheltering in the hedges along {street}
variants.body: A red flash deep in the dripping green, dry and patient.

variants.title: The moths are hiding under leaves
variants.body: A raindrop is a big deal when you're a moth. They're clinging to the underside of a leaf, waiting.

variants.title: No moths at the porch light tonight
variants.body: They're tucked under leaves and eaves, dry, waiting for the rain to stop.

variants.title: Moths are hiding from the rain near {green}
variants.body: Clinging upside down under the leaves while the drops patter on top.

variants.title: A song sparrow is singing the rain away
variants.body: The shower is easing, the air smells like wet earth, and a song sparrow is the first to start up again.

variants.title: A wet little sparrow is singing anyway
variants.body: Dripping on top of a shrub, singing their whole song in the drizzle.

variants.title: A song sparrow is singing after the rain near {water}
variants.body: Wet feathers, bright voice, the first song of the clearing sky.

variants.title: A bumble bee is hiding under a flower
variants.body: Rain is too heavy to fly in, so she's tucked beneath a petal, waiting it out.

variants.title: A wet bumble bee is warming up
variants.body: When the rain stops, she'll shiver her flight muscles until she's warm enough to buzz off.

variants.title: A bumble bee is sheltering under the flowers near {green}
variants.body: Clinging under a petal, fuzzy and a little damp, waiting for a break in the rain.

variants.title: The starlings are shining in the rain
variants.body: Wet feathers flash purple and green. They're poking the soggy lawn for grubs.

variants.title: Starlings are chattering on the wet lawn
variants.body: Rain brings bugs up, and the starlings are probing the grass like little sewing machines.

variants.title: Starlings are probing the wet lawn near {green}
variants.body: Glossy and rain-speckled, stabbing the soft ground for grubs.

variants.title: The chimney swifts are flying low
variants.body: Rain pushes the bugs down, so the swifts are swooping just over the rooftops, twittering.

variants.title: Swifts are skimming through the drizzle
variants.body: They eat only in flight, so they're out in it, darting under the clouds.

variants.title: Chimney swifts are swooping low above {street}
variants.body: Chasing bugs the rain knocked out of the sky.

variants.title: A turtle is watching the rain from underwater
variants.body: Just a nose poking up between the raindrop rings, breathing, then gone.

variants.title: No sunbathing today
variants.body: The turtles are all in the pond, where the rain sounds like soft tapping on a roof.

variants.title: A turtle is peeking up through the rain on {water}
variants.body: A tiny head among the raindrop rings, then a slow sink back down.

variants.title: A groundhog is staying in today
variants.body: Curled up in the burrow, dry and warm. The clover will still be there tomorrow.

variants.title: A groundhog is peeking out at the rain
variants.body: Nose twitching at the smell of wet earth, deciding: nope.

variants.title: A groundhog is waiting out the rain near {green}
variants.body: Just a whiskery nose in the burrow entrance, sniffing the wet air.

variants.title: An opossum is on a slug buffet
variants.body: Rainy nights bring out the slugs and snails. The opossum is strolling through the wet leaves, very pleased.

variants.title: An opossum is out in the drizzle
variants.body: Pink nose glistening, tail dragging through the wet grass, snuffling for snacks.

variants.title: An opossum is snacking in the rain near {green}
variants.body: Snuffling slowly through the wet leaves for slugs, nose first.

variants.title: The raccoons are staying in tonight
variants.body: Curled up in a tree hollow, listening to the rain, maybe skipping the trash run.

variants.title: A raccoon is washing their paws in a puddle
variants.body: Fresh rain, fresh puddles. They love feeling things with wet hands.

variants.title: A raccoon is splashing in a puddle along {street}
variants.body: Little hands patting the water, feeling for anything interesting.

variants.title: A spider is hiding at the edge of her web
variants.body: Raindrops are hanging on every thread like glass beads. She'll fix it when it stops.

variants.title: A web is full of raindrops
variants.body: Every strand sagging with shining drops. The spider is tucked in a leaf nearby.

variants.title: A spiderweb is beaded with rain near {green}
variants.body: Hundreds of tiny drops along every thread, while the spider waits it out.

variants.title: The brant are bobbing in the rain
variants.body: Small dark geese riding the gray swells, murmuring to each other, rain on their backs.

variants.title: A raft of brant is drifting in the drizzle
variants.body: Gentle grunts, rising and falling with the waves, totally at home.

variants.title: Brant are bobbing out on {water} in the rain
variants.body: A dark raft of little geese, rising and falling on the gray water.

variants.title: A grackle is stomping through puddles
variants.body: Yellow eyes on the soaked lawn, purple head slick with rain, looking for worms.

variants.title: A grackle is shaking off the rain
variants.body: Puff, shake, smooth. Back to strutting.

variants.title: A grackle is hunting worms on the wet grass near {green}
variants.body: Strutting through the puddles, shiny and dripping.

variants.title: A woodpecker is hiding on the dry side of the tree
variants.body: Pressed against the bark where the rain can't reach, waiting.

variants.title: A downy is tapping in the drizzle
variants.body: Wet bark is softer, and the bugs are right there.

variants.title: A downy woodpecker is sheltering on a trunk near {green}
variants.body: On the dry side of the bark, little and patient, listening to the rain.

variants.title: A red-winged blackbird is clinging to a wet reed
variants.body: The reed bends in the rain, and they ride it down and up again.

variants.title: Conk-la-ree in the drizzle
variants.body: A blackbird singing from a dripping cattail, red shoulders bright as ever.

variants.title: A red-winged blackbird is singing in the rain near {water}
variants.body: Swaying on a wet reed, shoulders flashing red.

variants.title: The snowbirds are in their element
variants.body: Juncos hopping on fresh snow, kicking it back with both feet to find seeds underneath. This is what they're named for.

variants.title: A junco is scratching in the snow
variants.body: Hop, kick-kick, peck. A tiny gray bird making tiny tracks.

variants.title: Juncos are hopping through the snow near {green}
variants.body: Little white tail feathers flashing, kicking up snow for buried seeds.

variants.title: A cardinal is glowing in the falling snow
variants.body: Bright red on a white branch, snowflakes landing on their crest. Basically a holiday card.

variants.title: A cardinal is fluffed into a red snowball
variants.body: Puffed up round, a few flakes on their back, crunching a seed.

variants.title: A cardinal is sitting in the snowy hedges along {street}
variants.body: Red against white, flakes drifting past, perfectly still.

variants.title: A squirrel is digging for buried nuts in the snow
variants.body: Nose first, snow flying, then a triumphant pop up with an acorn. They remember by smell.

variants.title: A squirrel is bounding through the snow
variants.body: Little leaps, tail up, a trail of paw prints in fours behind them.

variants.title: A squirrel is digging through the snow near {green}
variants.body: Snow on their nose, digging for a nut they buried in fall. Found it.

variants.title: A blue jay is shouting in the snow
variants.body: Bright blue on a white branch, yelling jay! jay! at the quiet. Somebody has to.

variants.title: A blue jay is shaking snow off a branch
variants.body: Lands, wobbles, and a little avalanche falls. Very dramatic.

variants.title: A blue jay is calling from a snowy branch near {green}
variants.body: Blue, white and loud, knocking snow off the twigs.

variants.title: A crow is sliding down a snowy roof
variants.body: Crows have been seen sledding on snowy roofs, again and again, just for fun.

variants.title: Black crows on white snow
variants.body: Walking on fresh snow, leaving big three-toed prints, cawing at the quiet.

variants.title: A crow is playing in the snow near {landmark}
variants.body: Hopping, sliding, poking the fresh snow with their beak, clearly enjoying it.

variants.title: The pigeons are huddled on a snowy ledge
variants.body: Snow piling up on the stone, birds puffed up in a row, standing on their own warm feet.

variants.title: A pigeon is catching a snowflake on their head
variants.body: Then another. They're just sitting there, getting gently frosted.

variants.title: Pigeons are huddled in the snow along {street}
variants.body: Puffed up together under a ledge, watching the flakes fall past.

variants.title: The sparrows are throwing a snow party
variants.body: Hopping in and out of the hedge, kicking up powder, chirping the whole time.

variants.title: A sparrow is perched on a snowy twig
variants.body: Fluffed round, tiny feet, flakes landing all around.

variants.title: Sparrows are chattering in the snowy hedges along {street}
variants.body: A whole crowd inside the bush, snow on top, noise inside.

variants.title: A white-throated sparrow is scratching under the snowy shrubs
variants.body: Two-footed hops, kicking snow aside, looking for seeds. White throat, yellow eyebrows, very dapper.

variants.title: Someone is whistling in the snow
variants.body: Oh sweet Canada, Canada, Canada. A white-throat, singing from under a frosted bush.

variants.title: A white-throated sparrow is hopping under the snowy bushes near {green}
variants.body: Kicking away the snow to get to the seeds underneath.

variants.title: The doves are lined up on a snowy wire
variants.body: Snow on their backs, fluffed into soft brown loaves, cooing quietly.

variants.title: A mourning dove is pecking seeds from the snow
variants.body: Soft and slow, little red feet in the white.

variants.title: Mourning doves are huddled on a snowy wire along {street}
variants.body: Fluffed up side by side, snow collecting on their backs.

variants.title: Snow is falling on the ducks
variants.body: Flakes landing on their backs and melting. The water is warmer than the air, so they're right where they want to be.

variants.title: A duck is asleep in the snow
variants.body: Head tucked into their back, snow collecting on top, cozy in their down jacket.

variants.title: Mallards are paddling through the snowfall on {water}
variants.body: Snowflakes vanishing into the dark water all around them.

variants.title: The geese are digging through snow for grass
variants.body: Pushing their bills through the white to find the green underneath.

variants.title: Geese are standing in the snow on one leg
variants.body: The other foot is tucked up into their warm feathers. Switch. Repeat.

variants.title: Geese are grazing through the snow near {green}
variants.body: Bills in the snow, snow on their backs, honking softly.

variants.title: A red-tailed hawk is watching the snow fall
variants.body: Perched high, feathers fluffed, snow on their shoulders. Fresh snow shows every mouse track.

variants.title: A hawk is hunting over the snow
variants.body: Fresh white ground makes everything easy to see from up high.

variants.title: A red-tailed hawk is perched in the snow near {landmark}
variants.body: High up, snow on their shoulders, eyes on the white ground below.

variants.title: The raccoons are sleeping through the snow
variants.body: Not hibernating, just staying in, curled up warm for days if they need to.

variants.title: Raccoon tracks in the fresh snow
variants.body: Little handprints, like a tiny person walked by. Someone went out for a snack.

variants.title: A raccoon is curled up while it snows near {green}
variants.body: Tucked in a hollow tree, tail wrapped around their nose, snow piling up outside.

variants.title: A titmouse is hiding seeds in the snowy bark
variants.body: Tucking a seed into a crack for later, crest up, snow on the branch.

variants.title: A titmouse is shaking snow off their crest
variants.body: A tiny gray bird, a big puff of flakes, then peter, peter!

variants.title: A titmouse is flitting through the snowy trees near {green}
variants.body: Big dark eyes, pointy crest, little flakes falling all around.

variants.title: The gulls are standing in the snow
variants.body: Pink feet on white sand, snow on their gray backs, all facing the wind.

variants.title: A gull is catching snowflakes
variants.body: Snapping at the falling flakes, maybe for fun. Probably for fun.

variants.title: Gulls are standing in the falling snow near {water}
variants.body: Pale gray birds, pale gray sky, snow drifting over the waves.

variants.title: The brant are bobbing in the snowfall
variants.body: Snowflakes melting on the waves as the little geese drift, murmuring.

variants.title: Brant are grazing on snowy grass
variants.body: Nibbling the green tips poking up through the snow.

variants.title: Brant are floating in the snow on {water}
variants.body: A dark raft of little geese, snowflakes falling all around them.

variants.title: A bufflehead is diving through the snowfall
variants.body: Pop up, shake off the snow, dive again. Tiny duck, big attitude.

variants.title: Buffleheads are bobbing like corks in the snow
variants.body: White patches and snowflakes, everything bright on the dark water.

variants.title: Buffleheads are diving in the snow on {water}
variants.body: Disappearing and popping back up as the flakes fall.

variants.title: A swan is gliding through the snowfall
variants.body: White on white on gray water. Very quiet. Very elegant.

variants.title: A swan has snow on their back

variants.body: The wire fades into fog on both sides.

variants.title: A dove is cooing softly in the fog along {street}
variants.body: The softest sound in the gray, damp air.

variants.title: A robin is singing in the fog
variants.body: Cheerily, cheer-up, from somewhere in the gray. The wet grass is full of worms.

variants.title: A robin is hopping on the misty lawn
variants.body: Every blade of grass beaded with droplets.

variants.title: A robin is singing somewhere in the fog near {green}
variants.body: A bright voice in a gray world.

variants.title: The fog is showing off every spiderweb
variants.body: Mist beads on the silk, and suddenly webs are everywhere: on railings, in shrubs, on fences.

variants.title: A web is glowing silver in the mist
variants.body: Every thread lined with tiny drops, and a spider in the middle.

variants.title: Spiderwebs are glowing in the fog near {green}
variants.body: Silver circles in every shrub, each one beaded with mist.

variants.title: A cormorant is a dark shape in the fog
variants.body: Perched on a piling, wings half open, the water disappearing into gray.

variants.title: A cormorant just dove into the misty water
variants.body: A ripple, then nothing, then a head pops up far away.

variants.title: A cormorant is perched in the fog near {water}
variants.body: A dark shape on a piling, wings half out.

variants.title: Ducks are quacking in the fog
variants.body: Quacks drifting across the water, ducks invisible, then a soft wake.

variants.title: A duck is paddling out of the mist
variants.body: A little V of ripples on silver water.

variants.title: Mallards are drifting through the fog on {water}
variants.body: Soft quacks and silver ripples in the mist.

variants.title: A night heron is hunched in the mist
variants.body: Red eyes glowing through the gray, perfectly still on the rocks.

variants.title: Quok! from somewhere in the fog
variants.body: A night heron, calling as they fly to the water.

variants.title: A night heron is waiting in the fog near {water}
variants.body: Hunched on the rocks, red-eyed, patient.

variants.title: A swan is gliding out of the fog
variants.body: White bird, white mist. Almost invisible, then there.

variants.title: A swan is drifting on the silver water
variants.body: The fog makes everything quiet. The swan fits right in.

variants.title: A swan is gliding through the fog on {water}
variants.body: A white shape slowly appearing out of the white mist.

variants.title: Terns are calling in the fog
variants.body: Sharp kee-arr calls from the mist over the water.

variants.title: A tern just dove out of the fog
variants.body: Splash, then a little silver fish in their beak.

variants.title: Terns are calling through the fog over {water}
variants.body: Sharp voices, quick wings, everything soft and gray.

variants.title: Brant are murmuring in the fog
variants.body: Low grunting calls, a raft of little geese, half lost in the mist.

variants.title: A line of brant just appeared in the mist
variants.body: Flying low over the water, soft calls, then gone.

variants.title: Brant are murmuring in the fog on {water}
variants.body: A dark raft of little geese, fading in and out of the mist.

variants.title: A squirrel is spiraling down a misty tree
variants.body: Damp bark, a flick of a wet tail, and they vanish into the gray.

variants.title: A squirrel's fur is beaded with mist
variants.body: Every hair holding a tiny drop. Shake. Better.

variants.title: A squirrel is scampering through the fog near {green}
variants.body: A gray tail disappearing into gray air.

variants.title: The pigeons are sitting out the fog
variants.body: Rooftops fading into mist, and a row of quiet pigeons waiting for it to lift.

variants.title: A pigeon flock just vanished into the fog
variants.body: Wings clapping, then nothing but gray.

variants.title: Pigeons are waiting on a foggy rooftop near {landmark}
variants.body: The skyline gone, just a row of puffed-up birds.

variants.title: A song sparrow is singing in the mist
variants.body: The marsh is gone in the gray, but one sparrow is singing like nothing's different.

variants.title: A wet sparrow on a misty shrub
variants.body: Beads of fog on every twig, one small bird among them.

variants.title: A song sparrow is singing in the fog near {water}
variants.body: A clear little song from somewhere in the gray.

variants.title: A heron is stepping into the shallows
variants.body: One slow foot, then the other, so the water barely ripples. The fish haven't noticed. Yet.

variants.title: The heron's first fishing trip of the day
variants.body: Long neck pulled into an S, eyes on the water, perfectly still in the pale light.

variants.title: A great blue heron is wading at first light near {water}
variants.body: Slow, careful steps through the cold shallows, looking for breakfast.

variants.title: A heron is flying home with slow, huge wingbeats
variants.body: Neck tucked, legs trailing behind like a kite string, a low croak as they pass.

variants.title: A heron is croaking in the dusk
variants.body: It sounds like a grumpy old door. That's a heron, heading to their roost.

variants.title: A great blue heron is flying low over {water} at dusk
variants.body: Big gray wings, slow and steady, long legs trailing behind.

variants.title: A heron is asleep standing up
variants.body: Up in a tall tree, neck folded down onto their chest, one leg tucked away.

variants.title: The heron is roosting high in the trees
variants.body: Out of reach of everything, balanced on a big branch, sleeping like a statue.

variants.title: A great blue heron is sleeping in the tall trees near {green}
variants.body: Neck folded, one leg up, perfectly balanced all night.

variants.title: A heron is fixing their feathers
variants.body: Long neck twisting all the way around, combing each feather with that dagger beak.

variants.title: A heron is sunning with wings held out
variants.body: Wings drooped open like a cape, soaking up warmth on the bank.

variants.title: A great blue heron is preening on the bank near {water}
variants.body: Combing out every feather, one at a time, very particular about it.

variants.title: The night herons are coming home to bed
variants.body: After a night of fishing, they're flying back into the trees, quok, quok, as everyone else wakes up.

variants.title: A night heron is ending their shift
variants.body: Everyone else is waking up. This hunched gray bird is going to sleep.

variants.title: Night herons are flying back to their roost near {green}
variants.body: Quok! Quok! Coming home from a night of fishing just as the sun comes up.

variants.title: A night heron is napping in the trees
variants.body: Hunched like a grumpy little old man, red eyes half closed, hidden in the leaves.

variants.title: Shh, the night herons are sleeping
variants.body: A whole group, tucked into the branches over the water, not moving at all.

variants.title: Night herons are napping in the trees by {water}
variants.body: Hunched and still, red eyes barely open, waiting for evening.

variants.title: The night herons are waking up
variants.body: Stretching, shaking out, then off to the water's edge as the light fades.

variants.title: A night heron is heading out to fish
variants.body: Their workday starts when everyone else's ends.

variants.title: A night heron is starting their night shift near {water}
variants.body: Flying low to the rocks as the light goes, red eyes ready.

variants.title: A swan is gliding through the morning mist
variants.body: Neck curved, barely moving, leaving a long V of ripples on the still water.

variants.title: A swan is tipping up for breakfast
variants.body: Head and neck underwater, white bottom pointed at the sky. Very dignified. Mostly.

variants.title: A swan is gliding through the early light on {water}
variants.body: Silent and white, leaving a long trail of ripples behind.

variants.title: The swans are drifting together at dusk
variants.body: Swan pairs stay together for years. Side by side, glowing pink in the last light.

variants.title: A swan is tucking in for the night
variants.body: Head turned back, beak buried in their back feathers, floating like a white pillow.

variants.title: A pair of swans is drifting together on {water}
variants.body: Side by side in the evening light, close and quiet.

variants.title: A swan is asleep on the water
variants.body: Floating in the dark, head tucked into their wing, rocking gently.

variants.title: The swans are sleeping out on the pond
variants.body: Safe from anyone on land, two pale shapes in the dark.

variants.title: Swans are sleeping out on {water}
variants.body: Two pale shapes floating in the dark, heads tucked in.

variants.title: The ducks are waking up with a stretch
variants.body: One wing out, one leg out, a big flap, a little quack. Good morning, pond.

variants.title: A mallard is dabbling for breakfast
variants.body: Bottom up, tail wiggling, nibbling plants from the bottom.

variants.title: Mallards are starting the day on {water}
variants.body: Stretching, flapping, quacking, and tipping up for breakfast.

variants.title: A duck is napping on one leg
variants.body: On the bank, head tucked, one eye open just in case.

variants.title: A mallard is preening in the sun
variants.body: Running their bill over every feather, spreading waterproof oil.

variants.title: Mallards are napping on the bank near {water}
variants.body: Heads tucked into their backs, one eye open, very relaxed.

variants.title: The ducks are gathering for the night
variants.body: Paddling in close together, quacking softly to each other.

variants.title: A mallard is the last one off the lawn
variants.body: Waddling back to the water as the light goes.

variants.title: Mallards are gathering together on {water} at dusk
variants.body: Paddling in close, soft quacks, settling down for the night.

variants.title: Geese are flying out in a V
variants.body: Honking to keep the group together, heading for their favorite grassy breakfast spot.

variants.title: A goose is honking good morning
variants.body: And then all the others honk back. It's a whole conversation.

variants.title: Geese are flying out above {water} in a V
variants.body: Honking as they go, heading to the grass for breakfast.

variants.title: A goose is standing guard
variants.body: Head up, watching, while the rest of the flock eats. They take turns.

variants.title: The geese are grazing in a line
variants.body: Moving across the grass together, nibbling as they go.

variants.title: Geese are grazing on the grass near {green}
variants.body: One stands guard, head high, while the others munch.

variants.title: The geese are heading to the water for the night
variants.body: Sleeping on the water keeps them safe. One by one they paddle out.

variants.title: A goose family is settling in
variants.body: Parents on the outside, everyone tucked close.

variants.title: Geese are paddling out onto {water} for the night
variants.body: Settling down together where it's safe.

variants.title: The geese are asleep on the water
variants.body: A raft of dark shapes, heads tucked, one or two always half awake.

variants.title: A sleepy honk in the dark
variants.body: Someone in the flock just checked in. Everyone's fine.

variants.title: Geese are sleeping out on {water}
variants.body: Heads tucked, floating together, a sentry always half awake.

variants.title: The brant are murmuring at sunrise
variants.body: A soft, gargly chatter from a raft of little geese, rising and falling with the waves.

variants.title: Brant are flying low over the water
variants.body: A wavy line of dark little geese, skimming the surface.

variants.title: Brant are murmuring on {water} at sunrise
variants.body: Little dark geese bobbing together, chattering softly.

variants.title: The brant are heading out to sleep on the water
variants.body: Low gargling calls as the raft drifts away from shore.

variants.title: A line of brant is flying home
variants.body: Low over the waves, wingbeats quick, dark against the sunset.

variants.title: Brant are drifting out on {water} for the night
variants.body: A dark raft of little geese, murmuring as the light fades.

variants.title: The brant are asleep on the harbor
variants.body: Floating together in the dark, rising and falling with the swell.

variants.title: Brant are murmuring in the dark
variants.body: Even at night, they keep up a soft, sleepy chatter.

variants.title: Brant are sleeping out on {water}
variants.body: A dark raft of little geese, rocking with the waves all night.

variants.title: A bufflehead is diving until the last light
variants.body: Pop up, look around, dive again. Little ducks need a lot of snacks.

variants.title: The buffleheads are gathering together
variants.body: A small flock floating close, black and white glowing in the dusk.

variants.title: Buffleheads are diving in the last light on {water}
variants.body: Pop, dive, pop, dive, little black-and-white corks.

variants.title: The buffleheads are sleeping on the water
variants.body: Tiny ducks, heads tucked, floating in a little group far from shore.

variants.title: A bufflehead is bobbing in the dark
variants.body: Small, round and asleep, rising and falling with the waves.

variants.title: Buffleheads are asleep out on {water}
variants.body: A little group of tiny ducks, tucked in, far from shore.

variants.title: A bufflehead is showing off
variants.body: Head bobbing, white crest puffed up, chasing around a female. She's not impressed. Yet.

variants.title: The buffleheads are flirting
variants.body: Males puff up their big white head patches and bob. It's a whole dance.

variants.title: A bufflehead is courting on {water}
variants.body: Puffed-up white head, bobbing and splashing, trying very hard.

variants.title: A line of cormorants is flying home
variants.body: Dark birds in a long row, low over the water, heading to their roost.

variants.title: The cormorants are lining up on a piling
variants.body: Wings half open, settling in for the evening.

variants.title: Cormorants are flying low over {water} to roost
variants.body: A long dark line skimming the water as the light fades.

variants.title: The cormorants are roosting together
variants.body: Lined up on old pilings and bridges, shoulder to shoulder, asleep.

variants.title: A cormorant is asleep on a piling
variants.body: Head tucked, balanced over the dark water.

variants.title: Cormorants are roosting on the old pilings by {water}

variants.title: A cormorant just came up with a fish

variants.body: Gone for half a minute, then up again, fish in beak.

variants.title: The terns are gathering on the sand
variants.body: Crowded together, chattering, a few still bringing fish to their kids.

variants.title: A tern is bringing a fish to their partner
variants.body: A gift. If it's accepted, they're a couple.

variants.title: Terns are gathering on the shore near {water}

variants.title: A sleepy kee-arr in the dark
variants.body: Even at night, the tern colony isn't completely quiet.

variants.title: Terns are roosting together near {water}
variants.body: A pale crowd on the sand, all facing the wind, asleep.

variants.title: The terns are out fishing early
variants.body: Hovering, folding up, splash. First fish of the day.

variants.title: A tern is calling over the morning water
variants.body: Kee-arr! Sharp and bright over the waves.

variants.title: Terns are fishing early above {water}
variants.body: Hover, dive, splash, then up with a silver fish.

variants.body: Hidden deep in a tree, crest flat, not a peep until morning.

variants.title: A blue jay is sleeping in the trees near {green}
variants.body: Tucked against the trunk, finally quiet.

variants.body: Jays can copy a red-tailed hawk's scream. Maybe to scare off other birds. Maybe for fun.

variants.body: A whole gang yelling at a perched hawk until they give up and leave.

variants.title: Blue jays are mobbing a hawk near {green}
variants.body: Yelling and diving until the hawk decides to go somewhere quieter.

variants.title: A cardinal is asleep deep in the hedge
variants.body: Fluffed into a red ball, tucked in the thickest tangle, safe till morning.

variants.title: The cardinals are sleeping close by each other
variants.body: Pairs often roost near each other in the same thick bush.

variants.title: A cardinal is sleeping in the hedges along {street}
variants.body: A red puff in the dark tangle, waiting for morning.

variants.title: A cardinal is cracking seeds
variants.body: Turning each seed in that thick orange beak, crack, spit the shell, swallow.

variants.title: The female cardinal is just as bright
variants.body: Warm brown with red on her wings, crest and tail, and an orange beak.

variants.title: A cardinal is snacking in the bushes along {street}
variants.body: Crack, spit, swallow, one seed after another.

variants.body: They think the bird in the window is a rival. They'll keep at it for days. Nobody wins.

variants.title: A cardinal is chasing off a rival
variants.body: Two red flashes zipping through the hedge, then one comes back looking smug.

variants.title: A cardinal is defending their territory along {street}
variants.body: Chasing off any other cardinal who dares to come close.

variants.title: A downy woodpecker is grabbing one last snack
variants.body: Hitching up a branch, tapping, prying out a beetle before bed.

variants.title: A downy woodpecker is grabbing a last snack near {green}
variants.body: Hopping up the bark, tapping, finding one more bug.

variants.title: A woodpecker is hanging on a weed stem

variants.title: A downy is upside down on a branch
variants.body: Small enough to dangle from twigs no other woodpecker could hold.

variants.title: A downy woodpecker is picking grubs from weed stems near {green}
variants.body: Tiny enough to cling to a goldenrod stalk and dig out the bugs inside.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is calling before bed
variants.body: Churr, churr, then into a tree hole for the night.

variants.title: A woodpecker is checking their sleeping hole
variants.body: Poking their head in, looking around, then squeezing inside.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is heading to bed near {green}
variants.body: One last churr, then into a hole in a dead branch.

variants.title: A woodpecker is asleep in a tree hole
variants.body: Clinging to the inside wall, propped up by their stiff tail, cozy and dry.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is sleeping inside a dead branch
variants.body: Snug in a hole they carved themselves.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is asleep in a tree near {green}
variants.body: Inside a little cave in the wood, propped up on their tail.

variants.title: A woodpecker is drumming good morning

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is popping out of their hole
variants.body: Head first, a quick look around, and off to find breakfast.

variants.title: A red-bellied woodpecker is drumming at dawn near {green}
variants.body: A quick drumroll on hollow wood, echoing across the trees.

variants.title: A titmouse is stashing a seed for tomorrow
variants.body: Tucking it into a crack in the bark, then hopping off to bed.

variants.title: The titmice are heading to their roost holes
variants.body: Little gray birds slipping into tree cavities for the night.

variants.title: A titmouse is hiding one last seed near {green}
variants.body: Wedging it into the bark for breakfast tomorrow.

variants.title: A titmouse is asleep in a tree hole
variants.body: Tucked into a little cavity, crest down, fluffed up warm.

variants.title: The bossy little titmouse is finally quiet
variants.body: Asleep in a hole in a tree until morning.

variants.title: A titmouse is sleeping in a tree hole near {green}
variants.body: Crest flat, feathers fluffed, warm and quiet.

variants.title: A titmouse is first to start whistling
variants.body: Peter, peter, peter, before the light is even up.

variants.title: A titmouse is scolding a squirrel
variants.body: Tiny, gray and very loud. The squirrel does not care.

variants.title: A titmouse is whistling in the early light near {green}
variants.body: Peter, peter, peter, bright and loud.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is making a last pass
variants.body: Low and fast through the trees as the small birds hurry to bed.

variants.title: Everyone's hiding: a Cooper's hawk is out
variants.body: The songbirds go silent all at once.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is hunting at dusk near {green}
variants.body: Fast and low between the trees, one last try before dark.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is asleep in a tall tree
variants.body: Perched close to the trunk, head tucked, out of sight.

variants.title: The hawk is resting tonight
variants.body: Even fierce hunters need sleep. Tucked into thick branches until dawn.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is roosting in the trees near {green}
variants.body: Tucked in close to the trunk, asleep.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is taking a bath
variants.body: Standing in a puddle or birdbath, splashing, looking surprisingly goofy.

variants.title: A hawk is drying off on a branch
variants.body: Feathers fluffed and wet, wings drooped, very un-fierce.

variants.title: A Cooper's hawk is bathing near {green}
variants.body: Splashing in shallow water, then shaking off like a wet dog.

variants.title: A peregrine is asleep on a ledge
variants.body: High above the city lights, tucked into a corner of the stone.

variants.title: The falcons are roosting on the bridge
variants.body: Perched on a high beam, the traffic far below.

variants.title: A peregrine is sleeping on a ledge high above {street}
variants.body: Tucked into the stone, city lights glowing below.

variants.title: A peregrine is watching the sunrise from a skyscraper
variants.body: Perched at the edge, catching the first light, eyes on the pigeons below.

variants.title: A falcon is stretching on a ledge
variants.body: One wing down, one leg back, a big stretch, then a shake.

variants.title: A peregrine is perched at first light high above {street}
variants.body: Catching the first sun, watching the rooftops wake up.

variants.title: A mockingbird is warming up their playlist
variants.body: A blue jay, a cardinal, a car alarm, a robin. Each one twice. Then the next.

variants.title: A mockingbird is on the highest perch around
variants.body: Tail flicking, singing everyone else's songs at the sunrise.

variants.title: A mockingbird is singing from the rooftops along {street}
variants.body: Song after song, borrowed from every bird on the block.

variants.title: A mockingbird is asleep in the berry bush
variants.body: Sleeping right in the middle of the bush they guard. Very committed.

variants.body: In fall and winter they don't sing at night. Tucked in their bush, asleep.

variants.title: A mockingbird is sleeping in their berry bush along {street}
variants.body: Guarding it even in their sleep.

variants.title: A catbird is peeking out of the shrubs
variants.body: Black cap, gray body, a flash of rusty orange under the tail.

variants.title: A catbird is meowing in the shrubs near {green}
variants.body: A long, rambling morning song from somewhere in the bushes.

variants.title: A catbird is singing the evening away

variants.title: A catbird is settling into the thicket
variants.body: One last mew, then quiet.

variants.title: A catbird is singing at dusk near {green}
variants.body: Rambling quietly from inside the bushes as the light goes.

variants.title: A catbird is asleep in the thicket
variants.body: Deep in the tangle, safe from cats (the real ones).

variants.title: The meowing bird is sleeping
variants.body: Tucked into the thickest bush, quiet until morning.

variants.title: A catbird is sleeping in the shrubs near {green}
variants.body: Deep in the tangle, out of sight, quiet.

variants.title: The blackbirds are flocking to the marsh to sleep

variants.body: They sleep clinging to the stems over the water.

variants.title: Red-winged blackbirds are settling into the reeds near {water}
variants.body: A noisy crowd, slowly going quiet as it gets dark.

variants.title: The blackbirds are asleep in the reeds
variants.body: Clinging to the stems over the water, where it's hard for anyone to sneak up.

variants.title: A red-wing is sleeping on a cattail
variants.body: Swaying gently in the dark, holding on even in their sleep.

variants.title: Red-winged blackbirds are sleeping in the reeds near {water}
variants.body: Clinging to the stems over the water, swaying in the dark.

variants.title: A female red-wing is weaving a nest
variants.body: Streaky brown, very busy, lashing grass to the cattail stems.

variants.title: A red-winged blackbird is chasing a crow
variants.body: Tiny bird, huge attitude. They'll chase anyone near the nest.

variants.title: A red-winged blackbird is defending the marsh near {water}
variants.body: Chasing off crows, hawks and anyone else who gets too close.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is the last one on the ground
variants.body: Hopping through the dim leaves, lifting their tail slowly, quietly.

variants.title: A thrush is calling chuck, chuck in the dusk
variants.body: A soft, low call from somewhere in the thicket.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is foraging in the dusk near {green}
variants.body: Quiet hops through the leaf litter as the light fades.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is asleep in the thicket
variants.body: Low in a dense bush, fluffed up, tail tucked.

variants.title: The shy thrush is resting
variants.body: Somewhere low and hidden, safe until morning.

variants.title: A hermit thrush is sleeping low in the bushes near {green}
variants.body: Hidden in the thickest part, fluffed and still.

variants.title: The juncos are gathering under the hedge
variants.body: A little gray flock, twittering, picking up the last seeds before bed.

variants.title: A junco is flashing white tail feathers
variants.body: Flick, flick, then into the evergreens for the night.

variants.title: Juncos are gathering at dusk along {street}
variants.body: Little gray birds twittering under the hedges before bed.

variants.title: The juncos are asleep in the evergreens
variants.body: Tucked into thick needles, fluffed into tiny gray balls.

variants.title: A junco is roosting deep in a shrub
variants.body: Out of the wind, little feet tucked up into their feathers.

variants.title: Juncos are sleeping in the evergreens along {street}
variants.body: Tiny gray puffs tucked deep in the needles.

variants.title: A white-throat is singing their evening song
variants.body: Oh sweet Canada, Canada, thin and clear in the dusk.

variants.title: White-throated sparrows are calling seet
variants.body: Soft little calls from under the bushes, keeping the group together.

variants.title: A white-throated sparrow is singing at dusk near {green}
variants.body: Oh sweet Canada, Canada, soft and clear.

variants.title: The white-throats are asleep in the brambles
variants.body: Low in a tangle, fluffed up, white throats tucked away.

variants.title: A sparrow is sleeping low in the thicket
variants.body: Hidden close to the ground where it's warmer.

variants.title: White-throated sparrows are sleeping in the brambles near {green}
variants.body: Low and hidden, fluffed up for the night.

variants.title: The white-throats are scratching for breakfast
variants.body: Hop back with both feet, kick the leaves, look for seeds. Repeat.

variants.title: A white-throated sparrow is singing at sunrise
variants.body: Oh sweet Canada, Canada, Canada.

variants.title: White-throated sparrows are scratching through the leaves near {green}
variants.body: Hopping backward, kicking up leaves for seeds.

variants.title: An opossum is heading home to bed
variants.body: Waddling along the top of a fence, tail held out for balance, very ready for a nap.

variants.title: An opossum is tucking in under a porch
variants.body: A long night of snacking. Time for a long day of sleep.

variants.title: An opossum is heading to bed along {street}
variants.body: Waddling home along a fence top as the sky gets light.

variants.title: An opossum is asleep in a cozy den
variants.body: Curled up under a deck or in a brush pile, snoring (probably).

variants.title: Shh, the opossums are sleeping
variants.body: They'll be up after dark to clean up fallen fruit and snails.

variants.title: An opossum is sleeping the day away near {green}
variants.body: Curled up in a hidden den, waiting for night.

variants.title: An opossum is waking up
variants.body: A big pink yawn with all fifty teeth. Then off on the evening rounds.

variants.title: An opossum is starting the night shift
variants.body: Nose twitching, heading out to look for snails, slugs and fallen fruit.

variants.title: An opossum is starting their rounds along {street}
variants.body: Sniffing along the fences, looking for dinner.

variants.title: An opossum is grooming like a cat
variants.body: Licking their paws and cleaning their face, very tidy.

variants.title: An opossum is snacking on fallen fruit
variants.body: Mulberries, cherries, apples, whatever dropped today.

variants.title: An opossum is snacking in the dark near {green}
variants.body: Snuffling through the grass for fallen fruit and snails.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is tucked into their tunnel
variants.body: Head in, shiny bottom out, done for the day.

variants.title: The carpenter bees have gone inside
variants.body: Each one curled up in a round tunnel in old wood.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is asleep in a wooden tunnel near {green}
variants.body: Inside a perfect round hole, waiting for the warm morning.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is warming up in the doorway
variants.body: Sitting at the entrance of their tunnel, waiting for the sun.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is peeking out
variants.body: Too cold to fly yet. Soon.

variants.title: A carpenter bee is waiting for the sun near {green}
variants.body: Peeking out of their tunnel in an old bench.

variants.title: A dragonfly is resting on a twig
variants.body: Wings out flat, holding on tight, waiting for tomorrow's sun.

variants.title: The blue dashers have gone quiet
variants.body: They need warmth to fly, so they rest in the plants all night.

variants.title: A blue dasher is resting in the plants near {water}
variants.body: Wings flat, holding still until the morning warms up.

variants.title: A blue dasher just snatched a mosquito
variants.body: Out, grab, back to the perch, in less than a second.

variants.title: Two blue dashers are chasing each other
variants.body: A zigzag fight over the best perch on the pond.

variants.title: A blue dasher is hunting mosquitoes above {water}
variants.body: Zip out, snap, back to the same twig.

variants.title: The milkweed bugs are huddled on a pod
variants.body: Packed together, orange and black, resting until the sun comes back.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are tucked under the leaves
variants.body: Out of the dew, waiting for morning.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are huddled together near {green}
variants.body: Clustered on the milkweed, resting for the night.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are covered in dew
variants.body: Tiny drops on their orange backs, waiting to warm up.

variants.title: A milkweed bug is sipping from a seed pod
variants.body: Beak like a straw, poked right into the milkweed seeds.

variants.title: Milkweed bugs are waking up on the milkweed near {green}
variants.body: Dewy and slow, waiting for the sun to warm them.

variants.title: The turtles are asleep underwater
variants.body: Resting on the bottom or tucked by a log, coming up now and then for a breath.

variants.title: A turtle is floating in the dark
variants.body: Just their nose above the water, dozing.

variants.title: Turtles are sleeping underwater in {water}
variants.body: Resting on the bottom, coming up now and then for a sleepy breath.

variants.title: A turtle is swimming slowly along the bottom
variants.body: Nibbling plants, poking around, totally unhurried.

variants.title: A turtle is stretching their neck way out
variants.body: Turtles can stretch their neck surprisingly far to look around.

variants.title: A turtle is cruising slowly through {water}
variants.body: Paddling along, nibbling water plants, never in a hurry.

variants.title: A groundhog is getting in one last snack
variants.body: Munching fast before heading underground for the night.

variants.title: A groundhog is sitting up at the burrow door
variants.body: Tall and still, one last look around, then gone.

variants.title: A groundhog is grabbing a last snack near {green}
variants.body: Munching quickly at the edge of the grass, close to the burrow.

variants.title: A groundhog is asleep underground
variants.body: In a cozy grass-lined room at the end of a long tunnel.

variants.title: The groundhogs are tucked in their burrows
variants.body: Groundhogs sleep all night, unlike their raccoon neighbors.

variants.title: A groundhog is asleep in a burrow near {green}
variants.body: Curled up in a grassy room underground.
